title: Someone on the Porch
summary: On Day seven, Nora faces the visitor who knew where the cabin was.

beats.text: Day seven. The porch board creaked again, and Pip gripped my sleeve.

beats.speaker: ava
beats.text: Ava lifted the poker. "If it knocks, we are not home," she whispered.
It did not knock. A folded paper slid under the door.
Neat handwriting. "I mean no harm. I have Jonah. Row out alone at dusk."
Pip burst into tears. Ava wanted the canoe immediately. I said no.
At noon I followed boot prints to the water. They stopped at the reeds.

beats.speaker: tess
beats.text: "Nobody rows across at night, Nora. The lake is crowded there," said Tess.
At dusk, a small light waited on the island shore. It blinked twice.

beats.speaker: ava
beats.text: Ava was already in the canoe. "You are not going alone," she said.
Halfway across, the lantern lit a face. A man in Walt's ranger jacket.
